\paragraph{Explicit data definitions and arc domain.}
$CH$ is supplied explicitly; $tsup_a$ is supplied as the aggregate available quantity of commodity $a$.
$SUP_{ao}$ allocates this aggregate supply among supply nodes.

All sums over $Y$ use only declared arcs; other entries are zero.
